author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override λ0.605 kd22 k50 δ0.12 (DAQB)
abstract: Same as δ0.10 but with δ=0.12 to probe slight density shift; expects parity with prior best while preserving PCR≈1.0 and cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
